question: When light is passed through a prism, refraction of light occurs:
solution:
The correct answer is __**two times.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Refraction of light** occurs when light passes through a prism because the prism causes the** light to bend or change direction **due to the change in speed of light in the prism.
 
• The refraction of light through a prism causes the different colors of light to **separate, **resulting in a** rainbow-like spectrum.**
 
• The amount of refraction that occurs depends on the** angle** at which the light enters the prism and the refractive index of the prism material.
 
• **When light is passed through a prism, refraction of light occurs twice.**
 
• This refraction undergoes at** two surfaces** of the prism, the **entry surface **and **the exit surface.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97bef6974ac5d8fd706122d6fffecb3114a5756a0bf13eaf547ee8bb08c965fa.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prism:**

 
 
• In the field of optics, a** **it is a** transparent substance,** such as glass, that has been precisely cut with **plane faces and angles**.
 
• It is used to **reflect and analyze** light. 
 
• A standard triangular prism can divide white light into its component colors, or what is known as a** spectrum.**
 
 
 
• **Refraction:**
 
 
• It is the **bending of light** as it moves from one transparent substance into another.
 
 
 
• The refractive index of a medium is a measure of how much the speed of light is reduced when it passes through that medium, compared to the speed of light in a vacuum.
